description: Context-safe final credits ledger query. Defaults to aggregated summary, supports precise search by entry type/direction/credit range, and writes large exports to a local JSONL file instead of returning all rows.

direction.description: consume for negative ledger entries, grant for positive entries. Default: any.

end_date.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today UTC.

entry_type.description: Filter by ledger entry type, for example consume_tool_execute.

limit.description: Max rows for search mode. Default 10, hard max 50.

max_credits.description: Maximum absolute credit amount to match.

min_credits.description: Minimum absolute credit amount to match.

mode.description: summary returns aggregates, search returns capped rows, export_file writes JSONL locally. Default: summary.

start_date.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to yesterday UTC.

name: credits_ledger
